title: American Restoration
description:
S03 E19 — Cannonball Safe
Rick and his guys restore a colossal 1920s cannonball safe; the shop freshens up some vintage farm tools.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S09 E42 — Breaking the Bank
One of Dr. J's supposed game-worn sneakers steps into the shop. Find out if the guys score a slam dunk.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S09 E14 — The Great Pawnbino
A personal check signed by Babe Ruth; Navy buttons that date back to the Civil War; Rick's back starts acting up and Chum tries to help.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S07 E03 — Three Pawn Night
The guys check out a Babe Ruth baseball card from his days with the Boston Red Sox; Corey eyes an officer's artillery sword from the War of 1812; Corey and Chumlee are offered a keyboard used by the band Three Dog Night.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S08 E06 — Dog Day Afternoon
Corey's dog spends the day at the shop; a cavalry sword used by John Wayne in the movie "Rio Grande"; Civil War medical syringe.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S08 E08 — Free Agent
A D. Moore pistol from the Civil War is brought into the shop; the guys check out a signed picture of President Benjamin Harrison; the guys put together a team to compete in a quiz competition.

title: American Restoration
description:
S03 E40 — Bombshell
An electric wheelchair made out of parts from a 1940s B-17 bomber is brought in; plus, Kelly's risqué photo shoot.

title: Grant
description:

title: Hitler's Secret Tunnels
description: Seventy years after the end of World War II, explorers Mike Scott and Luke Mahoney uncover a hidden Nazi document that reveals hundreds of miles of tunnels that may still be protecting Hitler's final secrets.

title: Tuskegee Airmen: Legacy of Courage
description: Exploring the legacy of the Tuskegee Airmen, the legendary group of African American pilots, revealing how these warriors for change helped end segregation in the military and pave the way for the civil rights movement.

title: Nazis on Drugs: Hitler and the Blitzkrieg
description: An incredible, long-hidden history of a devious plan to find the chemical edge the Nazis knew they would need to conquer the world; most shocking of all, this vast drug conspiracy is straight from rare historical records secured by the Allies.

title: Secrets in the Sky: The Untold Story of Skunk Works
description: For the first time in its 75-year history, Lockheed Martin is opening its hangar doors and pulling back the veil on the black world of its cloak and dagger Skunk Works program.
